```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```



```{r, warning = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
```

This file is used to clean up large TR master reports with YOP, Access_Method, and Access_Type to focus on only transformative agreement journals and to make sure all files fit under the TA usage upload restrictions (less than 20MB file size, fewer than 70,000 rows).


# Springer 

Our Springer agreement only applies to select journals, so this will clean up lots of unneeded rows.



## Load Raw Springer Usage and Title List

```{r, warning = FALSE}
setwd('C:\\Users\\aharrima\\OneDrive - University of Tennessee\\Documents\\Usage Database Update\\Agreement Manager Usage Holding Area') #Set this to the data's location on your local computer!

springerUse <- read_excel('Springer TR with YOP Raw Jan-Oct 2026.xlsx', skip = 14)
springerTitle <- read_excel('Springer TA Title List.xlsx', skip = 1)
```



## Limit Use to Only Title List Titles

```{r}
springerTAUse <- springerUse |>
  filter(Online_ISSN %in% springerTitle$`Online identifier`) |>
  filter(Metric_Type %in% c('Unique_Item_Requests', 'Unique_Title_Requests'))
```


## Clean up the Publisher

Only certain publishers are accepted for each vendor. This will automatically change every publisher to one that TA understands. The actual publisher isn't important in the TA's functionality.

```{r}
springerTAClean <- springerTAUse |>
  mutate(Publisher = 'SpringerOpen')

colnames(springerTAClean) <- c('Title', 'Publisher', 'Publisher_ID', 'Platform', 'DOI', 'Proprietary_ID', 'ISBN', 'Print_ISSN', 'Online_ISSN', 'URI', 'Data_Type', 'YOP', 'Access_Type', 'Access_Method', 'Metric_Type', 'Reporting_Period_Total', 'Jan-2026', 'Feb-2026', 'Mar-2026', 'Apr-2026', 'May-2026', 'Jun-2026', 'Jul-2026', 'Aug-2026', 'Sep-2026', 'Oct-2026')

springerTAClean
```


## Export Data

```{r, warning = FALSE}
setwd('C:\\Users\\aharrima\\OneDrive - University of Tennessee\\Documents\\Usage Database Update\\Agreement Manager Usage Holding Area') #Set this to the data's location on your local computer!
write_xlsx(springerTAClean, 'Springer TR with YOP Clean Jan-Oct 2026.xlsx')
```

## Limit Use to Only Title List Titles

Only certain publishers are accepted for each vendor. This will automatically change every publisher to one that TA understands. The actual publisher isn't important in the TA's functionality.

```{r}
tfTAClean
```

```{r, warning = FALSE}
write_xlsx(tfTAClean, 'Taylor and Francis TR with YOP Clean Jan-Oct 2026.xlsx')
```
